//: Surfaces this project has not built yet, each deferred until a date (1.1.0). A row skips the two device lanes, mobile-e2e and perf-lane, on a pull request, and nothing else: scheduled and dispatched runs keep both, and every other job ignores this file. Row shape: {"surface": "mobile", "deferredUntil": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": "<one line: why the surface is not built yet>"}. `mobile` is the one surface a row may name, one row per surface; deferredUntil is the last deferred day. A row is VOID, and the lanes run, as soon as any tracked file under apps/mobile/ differs from the sha the installer recorded in .harness/manifest.json, a file is added or a recorded one deleted there, or the manifest is absent: the first real screen re-arms the lanes. After deferredUntil a pull request runs them again, and the scheduled floor-review job reds naming the row. The changes job reads this file with `node tools/ci/surface-deferral.mjs --mode=pr`; run it locally to see what a pull request would do. Ships empty. Write-guard-protected, and an uncommitted edit reds gate-integrity: adding a row is a reviewed human act.
